leads.summary: Temperature can be available while the entire bar widget remains invisible if the condition icon is absent
leads.consequence: For a parsed current with a temperature but no usable weather code before an icon has ever been resolved, Panel.barLabel contains the temperature, but the existing widget-level visible binding checks only Panel.label and hides the entire pill. The missing-icon path therefore silently hides the new temperature even though the panel has it. No-data/error states and configured coordinates waiting on Open-Meteo can also leave label empty; a fallback icon or temperature-aware visibility would preserve the new readout. The visibility gate predates this PR, but now gates newly exposed temperature as well.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** on horizontal bars the widget shows `<icon> 21°C` (or `°F` with imperial units), and the slot grows to fit. Offscreen runs of the real widget behaved sanely with no data, without a `current` record, and with negative and three-digit temperatures. `weather-test.sh` passes at head (61 ok). The main issue is on vertical bars: the slot size is unchanged, but the icon is no longer optically centred.

### Vertical bars: the weather icon is drawn off centre

At base the button is `BarIconButton`, which draws the glyph through `OpticalGlyph` and centres the painted ink horizontally (`shell/Ui/BarIconButton.qml:23-39`). At head the vertical path uses a plain `WidgetButton`, which centres the `Text` layout box instead (`shell/Ui/WidgetButton.qml:79,86`). With the default JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, most weather glyphs at 13 px paint 11 to 16 px wide on a 7.8 px advance, so the ink lands right of centre (the clear-night moon, 8 px wide, is the exception).

Ink margins inside the 28 px vertical slot, left/right in px (offscreen renders of the real widget at base and head):

| condition | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| partly cloudy | 7/7 | 11/4 |
| sunny | 8/9 | 10/7 |
| fog, night | 8/7 | 12/3 |
| patchy rain | 7/7 | 11/4 |
| light rain | 9/8 | 11/7 |

**Impact:** the PR intends vertical bars to stay compact and icon-only, and the slot size (28x21) and content do stay the same, but the icon is now visibly off centre next to the other status icons. `test/shell.d/bar-icon-geometry-test.sh` holds the bluetooth, network, audio, monitor and power icons to within 0.5 px of optical centre, but weather is not part of that test, so nothing flags this.

**Suggested change:** keep `BarIconButton` with `slotSize: Style.bar.statusSlot` for vertical bars (and any icon-only case), and use `WidgetButton` only for the horizontal temperature label. Open PR #8666 switches between the two with a `Loader`.

### Horizontal bars: the icon crowds the temperature

`barLabel` is one string, `label + " " + temp` (`Panel.qml:150`), and the same glyph overhang covers much of the separating space. Measured ink gap between icon and first digit: 2 px for fog at night, 3 px for partly cloudy and patchy rain, 6 px for sunny and light rain. The digits themselves sit 2 to 4 px apart.

**Impact:** for several common conditions the icon sits as close to the number as the digits sit to each other, so the intended space between them is barely visible.

**Suggested change:** draw the icon and the temperature as separate items (for example the icon through `OpticalGlyph` and the temperature as its own `Text`) with an explicit gap.

### Open-panel dot does not follow the label width

`Bar.qml:1808-1813` sizes the open-panel dot from a widget's `openPanelIndicatorWidth` hint, falling back to 55% of the slot. The weather widget sets no hint, so the dot is computed from the padded slot rather than the text:

| label | dot | painted label |
|---|---|---|
| `<icon> 5°C` | 35 px | 39 px |
| `<icon> 21°C` | 39 px | 46.8 px |
| `<icon> -12°C` | 43 px | 54.6 px |

**Impact:** the dot is shorter than the painted label, and the gap grows as the label gets longer.

**Suggested change:** add `readonly property real openPanelIndicatorWidth: button.labelWidth` to the weather `BarWidget` root, as the clock does (`clock/BarWidget.qml:84-89`).

### Missing temperature field shows `undefined` in the bar

`reportTempNum` is `String(current.temp_C)` (or `temp_F`), so a wttr.in `current_condition` record without the selected-unit field makes the bar read `<icon> undefined°C` (`null°C` for a null value). The popup hero already shows this at base.

**Impact:** the PR also puts this text in the always-visible bar. The Open-Meteo path cannot produce it, and wttr.in's source does not drop these fields, so this is unlikely in practice.

**Suggested change:** pass the value through `Model.roundedTemp`, so the bar falls back to the icon only.

### Overlapping open PRs

- **#8666** adds the same feature as an opt-in `showTemperature` setting (default off). It keeps `BarIconButton` for icon-only and vertical bars, uses clock-like spacing, sets `openPanelIndicatorWidth`, and adds a manifest setting and docs. The two PRs' `weather-test.sh` assertions reject each other's implementation. Choosing between default-on and opt-in is a maintainer decision.
- **#11496** sizes the weather icon with `iconSlot` (27) instead of `statusSlot` and updates the contract fixture's vertical expectation, while this PR hard-codes `fixedHeight: root.vertical ? Style.bar.statusSlot : -1` and a test asserting that string.
- **#12183** edits the same `text:` and `visible:` bindings to keep the widget visible when wttr.in fails. Combined with this PR, `barLabel` would need reconciling: with an empty icon it is `" 21°C"` with a leading space, currently hidden only by the `visible` gate.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source review at `6af759c4` against base `7b336b1b`, plus isolated offscreen Qt Quick runs of the real `BarWidget.qml` and `Panel.qml` at base and head, with only the popup window stubbed. Measurements use Omarchy's default JetBrainsMono Nerd Font; a Nerd Font Mono variant was not measured and may reduce the overhang. `weather-test.sh` was run at base and head. The bar widget contract fixture ran offscreen at base and head with the same environment-only failures in both (the keyboard panel's layer-shell window is unavailable offscreen); weather's vertical size check passed in both. Not tested: a live Wayland bar or compositor, or live wttr.in responses.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
